name: Berserk
description:
Your Mana, Mana Regen, and Mana Heals convert into your Health pool instead of Mana. Abilities cost Rage, which only regenerates up to 25.

After building high Rage, you go Berserk for a duration, gaining Strength and a Health Shield. While Berserk, your Abilities transform and cost no Rage.

• Gain Rage by hitting Abilities, per Attack, and when you or a nearby ally takes damage
• Rage resets to 25 when you enter Berserk or respawn

name: Barbed Spear
description:
Thrust your spear forward, dealing Physical Damage to enemies in front of you and Stunning weaker minions. Barbs reduce their Healing received for a duration.

Berserk — Ground Slam: Slam your arms down, dealing Physical Damage and Rooting enemies in front of you.

• Hitting a minion restores Rage, more for a god, up to a cap

name: Vent Anger (A)
description:
Vent superheated steam for a duration, gaining Movement Speed and dealing Physical Damage to nearby enemies repeatedly. This drains your Rage and returns none.

Berserk: Vent Anger activates automatically and does not drain Rage.

name: Salmon's Leap
description:
Leap to a target location and slam down, dealing Physical Damage to enemies around and in front of you.

Berserk — Furious Charge: Charge forward, dealing Physical Damage, Stunning enemies and driving them back with you.
